title: Annotation steward rotation and drift amortization playbook
author: Aisha Kumar
content:
Summary:
This playbook defines a repeatable program for rotating annotation stewards, amortizing label drift remediation costs, and keeping probe/annotation inventories healthy across tenant cohorts. It combines human steward scheduling, automated drift detection, and sample-based reannotation to reduce cost while maintaining slice-level fidelity guarantees.

Purpose and scope:
- Purpose: Reduce time-to-detect and cost-to-repair annotation drift while ensuring service-level quality on critical slices (latency-sensitive, safety, and top-10 tenant slices).
- Scope: Applies to all production probes, human-labeled datasets, and stewarded annotation pools used by the Eval Harness, Prompt Catalog, and Onboarding pipelines. Excludes ephemeral synthetic probes created for single-shot diagnostics.

Principles:
1) Small, frequent steward rotations beat large, infrequent edits — maintains institutional knowledge while reducing bias accumulation.
2) Drift repairs are funded and prioritized by slice impact, not raw volume.
3) Prefer stratified sampling + targeted reannotation over full re-labeling when measurable quality recovery is achievable.
4) All remediation actions must be traceable and reversible; annotate changes with provenance metadata.

Definitions:
- Steward: a trained annotator (internal or contractor) assigned to own a set of slices / tenants for a rotation window.
- Steward rotation: scheduled handoff of ownership, knowledge transfer artifacts, and annotation backlog.
- Amortization: spreading the cost of reannotation across time and tenant cohorts using sampling and prioritization policies.
- Drift event: any alert where slice-level eval metrics (Fidelity Delta, Coherence Score, Anchor Loss) exceed configured thresholds.

Ownership and roles:
- Steward Lead (Applied ML): primary owner of scheduling, training, and steward health.
- Eval Owner (Service team): specifies slice SLA and approves reannotation budget for their service.
- Platform Ops: runs drift detection jobs and provides tooling for reruns and annotation assignments.
- Data Compliance: reviews high-sensitivity slice changes before remediation.

Steward rotation schedule and onboarding checklist:
1) Rotation cadence: 8-week windows for core stewards; 4-week windows for high-throughput slices.
2) Handoff items (to be included in rotation ticket):
   - Current slice inventory CSV (slice-id, priority, last-labeled, steward, failure-mode tags)
   - Known heuristics/labeling guidance docs (versioned)
   - Outstanding correction backlog and rationale
   - Recent drift incidents and mitigation history (links to triage notes)
3) Training checkpoint (first 3 days after takeover):
   - 8-hour shadowing with outgoing steward and evaluator team
   - 100 sample audit with kappa >= 0.75 against prior steward
   - Sign-off by Steward Lead recorded in ticket

Drift detection and alerting:
- Automated signals (run hourly, default):
  - Fidelity Delta (FD): 7-day rolling window increase > 6% triggers P1 candidate
  - Anchor Loss (AL): absolute anchor mismatch increase > 0.03 triggers P2 candidate
  - Coherence Drop (CD): decrease in coherence score > 0.08 triggers P2 candidate
- Composite rule: FD > 4% AND (AL > 0.02 OR CD > 0.04) => immediate steward assignment and start of amortization workflow.
- Alert destinations: steward on-call Slack channel, eval-owner pager if P1, and incident log in Opsboard.

Prioritization and amortization algorithm (high level):
1) Rank impacted slices by impact_score = (tenant_traffic_weight * fidelity_delta) + (sla_weight * slice_priority) - (annotation_age_factor).
2) Assign budget band: High (auto reannotation up to 5k samples), Medium (sample & validate 500–2k), Low (monitor + periodic sampling).
3) Choose repair mode: sample-relabel -> targeted augmentation -> synthetic expansion -> full relabel. Prefer the lowest-cost mode that historically achieves >=90% recovery for that slice class.

Sample-based reannotation protocol (step-by-step):
1) Pull stratified sample: 500 samples stratified by tenant and prompt-family.
2) Run double-blind annotation (two stewards); compute inter-annotator agreement (IAA).
3) If IAA >= 0.7 and fidelity improvement simulated >= target, schedule staged rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%).
4) If IAA < 0.7, escalate to expert adjudication and consider annotator retraining.

Cost allocation and billing tags:
- Each remediation job must attach the following billing tags: project_id, service_owner, slice_id, steward_rotation_id, cost_center.
- Cost is amortized across tenants by tenant_traffic_weight with a minimum 10% shared platform subsidy for safety-critical slices.
- Monthly cost report columns: steward_id, hours, samples_relabelled, infra_time_hours, total_cost_usd, allocation_split.

Quality gates and SLAs:
- Slicing SLAs (examples):
  - Top-10 tenant slices: Fidelity delta must be <3% over 30 days or remediation must complete within 7 days.
  - Safety slices: Any measurable semantic regression must be remediated within 48 hours with rollback plan.
  - Low-risk slices: Monitor; remediation within 30 days.
- Promotion gate for repaired slices: after staged rollout, run a 7-day shadow evaluation comparing pre/post labels. Passing criteria: net fidelity delta <1%, no increase in false positive safety flags.

Automated tooling and jobs (examples):
- drift-detector --slice-regex "^safety.*" --window 7d --thresholds fd:0.06,al:0.03,cd:0.08
- steward-assign --slice-id S-12345 --rotation 8w --handoff-ticket 5678
- sample-diff-analysis --before-labels s3://probes/before.csv --after-labels s3://probes/after.csv --metrics fidelity,coherence,anchor

Example YAML config for a slice (to be stored in repo: /datasets/slices/configs):
---
slice_id: S-12345
priority: high
steward_rotation_weeks: 8
fidelity_thresholds:
  fidelity_delta: 0.03
  anchor_loss: 0.02
  coherence_drop: 0.05
repair_budget_usd_month: 1500
billing_tags:
  project_id: eval-harness
  service_owner: payments-team
---

Escalation and rollback steps (operational runbook):
1) If a P1 drift alert triggers, steward creates triage ticket and notifies Eval Owner.
2) Run the stratified 500-sample pull and perform immediate spot-checks (1 hour).
3) If regression confirmed and safety risk assessed > medium: pause any rollout using affected labels, open emergency remediation ticket, and notify Data Compliance.
4) Execute a staged remediation: 10% -> validate 72h -> 50% -> validate 7d -> 100%. If at any gate metrics worsen, rollback to prior label snapshot (s3://probes/snapshots/<timestamp>).

Operational metrics dashboard (KPIs):
- Mean time to detect (MTTD) for drift events (target <= 12 hours)
- Mean time to remediate (MTTR) by slice priority (top-10 target <= 7 days)
- Annotation disagreement rate after steward rotation (target kappa >= 0.75)
- Cost per mitigated 1% fidelity delta (track trend monthly)

Reporting cadence and governance:
- Weekly steward sync (30 minutes): incoming handoffs, active drift items, backlog.
- Monthly cost & outcomes review with Product & Finance: present allocation reports and proposed budget adjustments.
- Quarterly audit: Data Compliance reviews a stratified set of label changes and steward decisions.

Appendices and references:
- Appendix A: Example ticket template (summary, slice metadata, sample links, remediations chosen, sign-offs).
- Appendix B: SQL for extracting impacted-slice telemetry: SELECT slice_id, avg(fidelity_delta) FROM eval_telemetry WHERE window=7d GROUP BY slice_id ORDER BY avg DESC;
- Related docs: probe-asset-deprecation-and-redistribution-playbook, annotator-calibration-for-longcontext-streaming-eval-playbook.
